lines.zh: 睫毛一样的鳍，在水里眨。
lines.en: Eyelash fins flicker in the water.

lines.zh: 丛林溪水浅，我们贴着沙。
lines.en: Jungle streams are shallow; we hug the sand.

lines.zh: 二到六只，一队掠过溪底。
lines.en: Two to six, sweeping over the creek bed.
A tree shadow shifts, and we turn.

lines.zh: 那些长须不是毛，是鳍条。
lines.en: Those long fringes are fin rays, not fur.

lines.zh: 藤蔓垂到水面，我们绕开。
lines.en: Vines reach the water; we veer around.

lines.zh: 溪水带着泥土和根的味道。
lines.en: The creek tastes of soil and roots.
Slow down; the long fins snag.
Our line isn't straight; it's loose.

lines.zh: 丛林太暗，我们靠水纹辨路。
lines.en: Too dark in the jungle; we read ripples.

lines.zh: 上头的叶子一直在滴水。
lines.en: Leaves overhead keep dripping.

lines.zh: 鱼群穿过的影子像一片睫毛。
lines.en: A school's shadow looks like lashes.
Stones on the bed are all mossy.

lines.zh: 顺着溪流拐弯，从不逆水。
lines.en: We always turn with the creek, never against.

lines.zh: 我蹭过石缝，苔藓沾在鳍上。
lines.en: I brush past a crevice, and moss clings to my fins.

lines.zh: 叶子滴下的水，把我推偏了一点。
lines.en: Water dripping from the leaves nudges me off course.
Eyelash fins droop, shading my eyes.

lines.zh: 溪底的沙很软，躺着舒服。
lines.en: Soft sand below; good to rest on.
Six of us, and none of us speak.

lines.zh: 一只青蛙在岸边看着我。
lines.en: A frog on the bank stares at me.
Long fins sway slowly with the current.

lines.zh: 水面上漂着落下来的花。
lines.en: Fallen blossoms float on the surface.
The jungle is loud; fish stay quiet.
I sweep sand from beside my eyes.

lines.zh: 这条溪里没有第二个家。
lines.en: No second home in this creek.

lines.zh: 阳光穿过叶子，一束一束。
lines.en: Sunlight comes through leaves in shafts.

lines.zh: 骨头磨的粉在底下慢慢化。
lines.en: Bone powder below dissolves slowly.
Two to six; just enough company.

lines.zh: 这里没有刷怪蛋，只有水。
lines.en: No spawn egg here, only water.
Rain's coming; the water's clouding.
You parted the vines and startled us.

lines.zh: 你一直盯着我眼旁那圈鳍。
lines.en: You keep staring at my eye fringes.

lines.zh: 我们长得怪，但不是怪物。
lines.en: We look odd, but we're not monsters.
Do you even know this jungle path?
Your boots still carry mud.

lines.zh: 别拿桶，我们没有刷怪蛋。
lines.en: No bucket needed; we have no spawn egg.

lines.zh: 溪水映出你的倒影，很高。
lines.en: The creek reflects you, very tall.

lines.zh: 我们只是鱼，不会说人话。
lines.en: We're just fish; we don't speak.

lines.zh: 你在这里找什么，苔藓吗。
lines.en: What are you after here, moss?

lines.zh: 往上游看，瀑布就在那里。
lines.en: Look upstream; the waterfall is right there.
One long fin broke; I swim crooked.
My eye fringe stings; ripples blur.
Six scattered; only three remain.
The creek ran red, then cleared.
We don't fight back; we hide.
Pain plasters my fin rays flat.
Squeeze into the crack; still room.
You hit the weakest one.
Injured in the jungle, you don't last.
Remember this creek; don't come back.

lines.zh: 溪里的小虫比你的饵香。
lines.en: Creek bugs smell better than your bait.

lines.zh: 撒下来，二到六只一起分。
lines.en: Drop it; two to six of us will share.
Hold still; the water's shaking.
Our mouths are small; break it up.

lines.zh: 长鳍颤了一下，是闻到味。
lines.en: My long fin twitches; I smell it.

lines.zh: 顺流下来的东西最好吃。
lines.en: Things drifting downstream taste best.
Step back so we dare come up.
We'll eat bone meal too; don't waste it.

lines.zh: 有人喂过我们，后来不见了。
lines.en: Someone fed us once, then vanished.

lines.zh: 那虫子再漂近点，就归我。
lines.en: Let that bug drift closer; then it's mine.
You're standing on my long fin.

lines.zh: 溪水一浑，睫毛都看不清。
lines.en: Creek's muddy; I can't see past my lashes.
Our line broke; fall back in.
The stones are slick; you nearly fell.
Don't touch the fringe by my eyes.
In a creek this narrow, make room.

lines.zh: 你踢起的沙盖住了我们。
lines.en: Your kick buried us in sand.

lines.zh: 撞得不重，鳍条折了一根。
lines.en: Light hit, but one ray bent.
Six fish dodging churned the water.

lines.zh: 我们是这里最小的东西。
lines.en: We're the smallest things in here.
Long fins touching, like a blink.
We spawn on mossy stones by the creek.
Two pairs formed within our school.
Don't stand on the bank watching.
Eggs hide in the dark of stone cracks.
Jungle water is just warm enough.
My fins are a little shorter than hers.
Two turns, fins overlapping, done.

lines.zh: 小鱼孵出来会跟着队伍。
lines.en: The fry will follow the school.
This creek will remember us.

lines.zh: 我们没有刷怪蛋，只有水桶。
lines.en: No spawn egg for us, just buckets.

lines.zh: 长鳍挤在桶里，卷起来了。
lines.en: Long fins cramped in the bucket curl up.

lines.zh: 丛林的水是绿的，这里不是。
lines.en: Jungle water is green; this isn't.

lines.zh: 六只里只装得下我一只。
lines.en: Only one of six fits in here.

lines.zh: 你打算把我放进哪条溪。
lines.en: Which creek will you put me in?

lines.zh: 桶里没有苔石，也没虫子。
lines.en: No mossy stones, no bugs in here.
When it sloshes, my eye fringes sting.
Don't seal the lid; I dislike the dark.
Can I go back to that jungle?
Remember to leave me a little bone meal.
The thing on the bank just stood up.
Wrong ripples; that's not a fish.
Fins tighten; hide under the stone.
That shadow is wider than the creek.

lines.zh: 我们六只，一起往深处退。
lines.en: All six of us back into the deep.
It's stepping into the water.

lines.zh: 眼角的鳍先感觉到震动。
lines.en: The fringe by my eyes feels the tremors.
Stay together; follow me along the bed.

lines.zh: 丛林里的东西都爱吃鱼。
lines.en: Everything in the jungle eats fish.
If it reaches in, we bolt.

lines.zh: 我们躲在苔石后面看你。
lines.en: We watch from behind the mossy stone.
Fin twitch; I'm measuring the distance.
The creek is shallow; we can't hide long.

lines.zh: 我们藏在苔下，只露鳍梢。
lines.en: We hide under moss, only fin tips showing.
Two to six of us, all watching you.

lines.zh: 眼旁那圈鳍已经张开了。
lines.en: The fringe beside my eyes has spread.

lines.zh: 你踩的石头是我们的屋顶。
lines.en: That stone you stepped on is our roof.
The current helps hide your scent.

lines.zh: 再靠近，我们就往下游跑。
lines.en: Closer, and we head downstream.
The jungle taught us not to gamble.
The long fin lashes like a whip tip.
Small mouths; we bite soft spots.
Six of us peck at your fingers.
Six mouths are waiting inside that crack.
One peck, then back under the mossy stone.
You broke the mossy stone; we remember.
The creek bed is slick; you wobble.

lines.zh: 眼角那圈鳍是会划人的。
lines.en: The fringe by my eyes can cut.
We circle back from downstream.
Bite, then vanish into stone cracks.

lines.zh: 丛林溪里自然多出几条。
lines.en: A few more appear naturally in the creek.

lines.zh: 不是被放的，是我们自己来的。
lines.en: Nobody placed us; we came on our own.
Under the mossy stone, long fins emerge.
Two to six; a fresh school.

lines.zh: 水温和光照刚好合我们。
lines.en: Water and light suit us just right.

lines.zh: 叶子上滴下的水把我们吵醒。
lines.en: Dripping leaves woke us up.
Born with that ring of long fins.
The creek will carry us downstream.
This jungle never lacks moss.

lines.zh: 我们只在这种群系出现。
lines.en: We only show up in biomes like this.
Even a jungle this wet can burn.

lines.zh: 从树冠掉进水里，摔懵了。
lines.en: Fell from the canopy into water, dazed.
The creek is right there; don't laugh.
The mossy stone blew into fragments.
Something sharp grazed my fin rays.

lines.zh: 水里浮起不属于丛林的光。
lines.en: Light not of the jungle glows in the water.
No bugs in the creek; starving and dizzy.
Lightning hit the canopy; the creek flashed white.

lines.zh: 没有溪，没有苔，什么都没有。
lines.en: No creek, no moss, nothing at all.
